intro: Near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, The Collector's Schedule marks when illicit gold shipments move through Elwynn Forest. Gnolls carry the handwritten itinerary, and Marshal Dughan recognizes the name it records.

p: The Collector's Schedule marks dates and times for gold shipments from Elwynn's mines. Stormwind has not officially worked the mines for months, driven off by banditry and creature incursions, yet ore still leaves in an orderly flow. The itinerary names the days and hours when a figure called The Collector receives each shipment. The trail points to a camp near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest. When Marshal Dughan sees the schedule, he recognizes the Collector's name. Who pays for the stolen gold remains unknown.
